svg.title: Chronometer - career timeline 2015 to now
svg.desc: Career as a chronometer dial where each hour mark is a year from 2015 to 2026, with a sweeping hand that highlights each role. FREDDIE MAC (JUL 2026 – NOW, finance · ml forecasting): Rejoined · FastAPI microservices on EKS/ECS serving ML models. CAPITAL ONE (MAY 2025 – JUL 2026, finance · card portfolio): 50+ microservice AWS platform · event-driven serverless pipeline. FREDDIE MAC (JAN 2023 – MAY 2025, finance · ml forecasting): Led the backend team · 3,000→1,000-line refactor, +20% perf. AGERO (APR 2022 – JAN 2023, serverless data sync): FastAPI on Lambda from scratch · S3 → EventBridge → MongoDB. HUMANA (MAY 2019 – APR 2022, healthcare · specialty pharmacy): Led backend agile team · Tesseract OCR apps via Flask + .NET. McKESSON (JUN 2018 – MAY 2019, pharma saas): Flask + MS SQL · Angular + C# Web API · Express portal (TDD). WOOLWORTHS (SEP 2017 – MAY 2018, retail · sydney): ASP.NET/C# N-tier · Azure App Insights · Sev-1 response. CVS HEALTH (JAN 2016 – AUG 2017, pharmacy apps): Led API development · AngularJS SPA from scratch. ANNA UNIVERSITY (2015, education): BE Mechanical Engineering · from gears to graphs.
